description: Send start, fail or an exit code by name, with the ingest key; the first signal of a new name creates its monitor. The same signals as `/in/:id/start`, `/in/:id/fail` and `/in/:id/:exit_code`, for a fleet that only knows the ingest key: the job sends its name, not the monitor id. The first signal of a new name creates the monitor, with the same rules and the same `cron`, `tz` and `grace_sec` as the plain ping by name.

signal.description: start, fail, or the exit code 0 to 255

slug.description: Name of the job; it becomes the monitor name.
